target: local static website served from outputs/glass-ui-website
provenance: Merged from complete per-engine reports after moving material styles into reusable CSS. Edge used Chromium CDP to verify prefers-reduced-transparency:reduce. Firefox and WebKit reported neither reduce nor no-preference and expose no such Playwright emulation; that operating-system preference branch was not certified there. Explicit reduced/static/no-blur and forced-colors fallback checks ran in every engine. Source hashes were not recorded. The supplementalRegression below verifies the final specificity fix across combined forced-colors and explicit fallback modes.

tests.name: Fresh dark material gate and solid, static, no-blur, forced-colors fallbacks
Fresh README screenshots from real desktop and mobile viewport

limitations: Automated desktop engine checks do not certify physical devices, all accessibility requirements, or production performance.
The large-text check doubles computed text sizes in a fresh context; it is not an OS accessibility-settings certification.

limitations: Headless Microsoft Edge with emulated forced-colors and contrast preferences; not a physical OS high-contrast certification.
Synthetic isolated component probes use forced-color-adjust:none to expose authored CSS rather than automatic browser color coercion.
This targeted regression covers forced-colors combined with explicit fallback flags, not the complete website regression or other browser engines.
